value: xteNCAM
Age-structured state-space population model that estimates F, M, and catch using fishery, survey, tagging, juvenile-survey, and Capelin information

notes: The model estimates stock history back to 1954.

value: Reported landings are treated as incomplete information about total removals; the model estimates catch within bounds

value: Catch bounds are set around reported landings and informed by available information on unreported removals
notes: Bounds account for partial reporting and recreational removals.

value: Catch-at-age composition uses separate estimated error scales for ages <=2, 3-4, and >=5

value: F is modeled with an autoregressive process across age and year; age correlation is zero below age 5 and estimated for ages 5-12
notes: Age/year autocorrelation describes the xteNCAM process structure.

value: M varies over age and year through an age-year correlated process
notes: The assessment estimates age- and year-varying M.

value: The selected formulation has a constant baseline M and an age-invariant Capelin effect; residual process variation remains
source_reference: DFO Research Document 2026/026, p. 10; DFO Research Document 2025/035, Sec. 2.1
notes: Do not read constant baseline M as constant total M; Capelin and process terms permit changes over time.

value: The Capelin-to-cod biomass ratio predicts M; acoustic Capelin biomass and cod fall RV biomass are used

notes: The Capelin effect is shared across ages in the selected formulation.
